questions.question: In the given bar-chart, which month sales show the maximum decrease (in Percentage) in 2018 as compared to 2017?
questions.solution:
Percentage decrease in May month = [(450 - 400)/450] × 100 = 11.11%

Percentage decrease in April month = [(200 - 180)/200] × 100 = 10%

Percentage increase in March = [(240 - 110)/110] × 100 = 118.18%

Percentage decrease in February month = [(350 - 300)/350] × 100 = 14.28%

Percentage increase in January month = [(230 - 220)/220] × 100 = 4.54%

Hence, maximum decrease (in Percentage) in February.

questions.question: In the given bar-chart, what is the total increase or decrease in percentage sale in 2018?
questions.solution:
Total sales in the year 2017 = 450 + 200 + 110 + 350 + 220 = 1330

Total sales in the year 2018 = 400 + 180 + 240 + 300 + 230 = 1350

Total increase in sales in 2018 = 1350 - 1330 = 20

Percentage increased by = (20/1330) × 100 = 1.5%

questions.question: The average age of a cricket team of eleven players is 27 years. If two more players are included in the team the average becomes 26 years, then the average age (in years) of the two included players is∶
questions.solution:
Average age of eleven players is = 27 years

Sum of age of 11 players = 27 × 11 = 297 years

If two players are included in the team, then average age of 13 players = 26 years

Sum of age of 13 players = 13 × 26 = 338 years

Sum of age of two players (included) = 338 - 297 = 41 years

Average age of two players (included) = 41/2 = 20.5 years

questions.question: A can do a work in 12 days while B can do same work in 18 days. How long (in days) will it take if they do the work together?
questions.solution:
A alone can complete the work in = 12 days

A’s one day work = 1/12

B alone can complete the work in = 18 days

B’s one day work = 1/18

(A + B)’s one day work = 1/12 + 1/18 = (3 + 5)/36 = 5/36

(A + B) together can complete the whole work in = 36/5 = 7(1)/(5)

questions.question: An alloy contains 32% copper 24% nickel and rest zinc. How much zinc is present in 12 kg of the alloy?
questions.solution:
Given, the alloy contains 32% copper, 24% nickel and rest zinc, then

questions.question: 6 men or 5 women earn Rs. 14,820 in two days. How much will 4 women and 6 men earn in one day?

questions.question: One fourth of a tank can be filled in 3 hours by pipe A and one-third of the same tank can be filled in 2 hours by pipe B. How long will it take for the tank to be filled if both the pipes are kept open?
questions.solution:
Pipe A alone can fill 1/4th tank in = 3 hrs

Pipe A alone can fill the full tank in = 3 × 4 = 12 hrs

A alone can fill the tank in 1 hr = 1/12 tank

Pipe B alone can fill 1/3rd tank in = 2 hrs

Pipe B alone can fill the full tank in = 2 × 3 = 6 hr

B alone can fill the tank in 1 hr = 1/6 tank

Pipe (A + B) can fill the tank in 1 hr = (1/12 + 1/6) = (1 + 2)/12 = 3/12 = 1/4 tank

Pipe (A + B) together fill the whole tank = 4 hrs

questions.question: The volume of a solid cylinder with height 6 cm is 231 cm³. The radius of the cylinder is∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height of the cylinder= 6 cm

Volume of the cylinder = 231 cm³

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fcf7ae97456b9580eba90f65c827a555fc9cceb3c9863e3584331236c42a467.png] **

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

where,

r = radius of cylinder

h = height of cylinder

**Calculations:**

Volume of cylinder = πr2h

⇒ 231 = (22/7) × r² × 6

⇒ r² = 231 × (7/22) × (1/6)

⇒ r2 = 12.25

⇒ r = √12.25

⇒ r = 3.5 cm

**∴ The radius of the cylinder is 3.5 cm.**

questions.question: The number 23474 is exactly divisible by∶
questions.solution:
**Divisibility law of 2****∶** A number divisible by 2 if its last digit is 0, 2, 4, 6 and 8.

**Divisibility law of 3****∶** A number divisible by 3, if the sum of its digit is divisible by 3

**Divisibility laws of 4****∶** A number divisible by 4, if its last 2 digit divisible by 4.

**Divisibility laws of 11****∶** If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because 2 - 3 + 4 - 3 = 0, which is a multiple of 11)

The number 23474 is divisible by 2 because its last digit is 4.

Sum of digit of the number 23474 = 2 + 3 + 4 + 7 + 4 = 20

The number 23474 is not divisible by 3 because the sum of its digit not divisible by 3.

The number 23474 is not divisible by 4 because its last 2 digit 74 not divisible by 4.

The number divisible by 11 because

2 - 3 + 4 - 7 + 4 = 0

10 - 10 = 0

0 = 0

Hence, the number 23474 divisible by 2 and 11 only.3a:T8e1,
